newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB's Pitman sees margin pressure.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB's Pitman sees margin pressure.

text.p: Sir Brian Pitman, current chief executive and chairman-in-waiting at Lloyds TSB Group, said on Monday he expected continuing pressure on margins in the company's financial services markets.

But he told Reuters television in an interview that the company's planned acquisition of the remaining 37.4 percent in life insurer Lloyds Abbey Life would help the company streamline so it could fight its rivals.
"One advantage that we think we have got is that we can reduce costs," he said, adding that this would "make life more difficult for our competitors".
Lloyds TSB said earlier that it expected to reap savings of 50 million pounds before tax withing three years after buying the remaining stake in Lloyds Abbey.
The deal would be "marginally" earnings enhancing in 1997 before the main savings emerge, it added.
